title: Greek Marinade (DRAFT)

items: ½ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper

reviewFlags: Source is a draft. Trailing 2s after rosemary and thyme were treated as stray characters.
headnote: Makes enough for 2-4 lbs of meat

components.title: Chicken
steps: Combine all of the ingredients in a blender until homogeneous.
Trim the chicken and marinade for 2-4 hours.
Grill over high heat until desired doneness, approximately 12-16 minutes.

components.title: Lamb
steps: Omit the yogurt and combine the rest of the ingredients in a blender until homogeneous.
Trim the lamb and marinate chops for at least 4 hours or larger cuts at least 8 hours.  Marinate overnight for maximum flavor.
Grill over high heat until desired doneness, approximately 10-15 minutes.
